annotations.title: College aid forms and need-blind policy

description: For one to twelve colleges: whether the CSS Profile is required, listed or not required, whether the FAFSA is listed, priority aid deadlines, the net price calculator link, and whether the school says family income or ability to pay is part of admission (need-blind) and whether it meets full demonstrated need, each with its source. Also gives the FAFSA tax-year rule and aid-year labels for the current and next aid year from studentaid.gov, computed from today's date. Anything a school did not publish reads "not published". Works without sign-in.

colleges.description: One to twelve college names, e.g. ["Vanderbilt", "University of Virginia"]
